statement: Every bridgeless graph has a list of cycles such that every edge lies in exactly two of them.
For every integer n>1 there exist positive integers a,b,c with 4/n = 1/a + 1/b + 1/c.
In every finite union-closed family of sets, some element belongs to at least half of the sets.

terms: perfect cuboid problem integer edges space diagonal
statement: There is no rectangular box with integer edges, face diagonals and space diagonal.
A Hadamard matrix of order 4k exists for every positive integer k.
